supporting_observations.claim: Repeated failed authentication attempts for svc-billing came from FILE-PIN-01 at roughly one-minute intervals. The failures report bad-password status, including 4625 events with SubStatus 0xc000006a and corresponding domain-controller authentication failures.

The recurring failures are consistent with the provided change-calendar and service context: the svc-billing password was scheduled for rotation at 13:30 UTC, while BillingSync on FILE-PIN-01 re-authenticates every minute. This makes stale credentials after rotation a plausible explanation, but does not establish that this is the cause.

At 14:05 UTC, a Windows PowerShell process running as SYSTEM used explicit credentials for svc-billing while targeting PROXY-PIN-01. This record shows an explicit-credential event, but does not show whether authentication succeeded or why the credentials were used.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs were not collected for PROXY-PIN-01 from 13:30 to 14:20 UTC because of a collection outage, so proxy-side evidence to corroborate the 14:05 explicit-credential event is unavailable.
The available records do not identify which host or person corresponds to source IP 10.51.20.10 in the 14:05 event.

Whether any unrecorded successful authentication or proxy activity occurred during the collection gap.

Identify the device assigned to 10.51.20.10 and collect its PowerShell, process, and authentication telemetry around 14:05 UTC.
